{"draft": "Dollar General Q2 FY2026 Recap
Results:
- Net sales: $11.3 billion, rose 5.2% from a year earlier
- Same-store sales: climbed 3.5%, with customer traffic up 2.0% and average transaction amount up 1.5%
- Gross profit as a percentage of net sales: 32.6%
- SG&A as a percentage of net sales: 25.8%
- Operating profit: $769.2 million, grew 29.2%
- Net income: $550.3 million, increased 33.8%
- Diluted EPS: $2.48, jumped 33.3%
Operations:
- Total merchandise inventories: $6.6 billion, slipped 2.7% on an average per-store basis
- New stores opened in the United States: 125
- Stores remodeled: 665 through Project Renovate and 711 through Project Elevate
Cash and capital:
- Remaining share repurchase authorization: $1.4 billion
- Quarterly cash dividend declared: $0.59 per share
Outlook:
- Fiscal 2026 capital expenditures expected: $1.4 billion to $1.5 billion
- New stores planned in the United States: approximately 450
- Real estate projects planned: approximately 4,730"}
